verdict.rationale: Orama Cloud exposes APIs and SDKs, so a downloadable API spec is a fair question, but the evidence shows no OpenAPI or equivalent spec: probes of all common OpenAPI/Swagger paths returned 404. The llms.txt file and the MCP server are different capabilities and earn no credit for this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
